content.value: [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] and wolf armour use fixed base stats equivalent to strong player sets. They cannot receive random, targeted, or Artificial runes. Its bonuses protect the animal wearing it, not the rider or a player holding the item.

[[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]] [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] Armour: +60 evasion and +15% base movement speed.
Golden [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] Armour: +55 armour and +35 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]]. It has no extra item rarity.
Iron [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] Armour: +120 armour and +20% knockback resistance.
[[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]] [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] Armour: +300 armour, +10 maximum health, and +0.75 health regeneration per second.
[[item/minecraft:wolf_armor|Wolf Armour]]: +120 armour and +20% knockback resistance, matching iron.

The equipped animal receives the matching armour, evasion, [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], life regeneration, health, speed, and knockback values while wearing the armour. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]] follows normal recharge and damage rules; [[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]] regeneration heals the wearer continuously.
Diamond animal armour restores Health to the animal wearing it. Carrying the armour in your own inventory does not heal you or your mount.
